successStories.quotes: From NYU rejection to Harvard acceptance
Turning challenges into milestones - that's what TopCoach taught me.
The biggest changes and opportunities in my life began at TopCoach, where I realized I was ready for greater success.
With the right guidance and determination, anything is possible.
TopCoach didn't just help me get into university - it helped me discover my potential.
Every setback was a setup for a comeback, thanks to the support I received.
The journey was tough, but the destination made it all worth it.
I learned that success isn't about perfection, it's about progress and persistence.

studentHub.gpaCalculator.whatIsGPA: What is GPA? Learn the Basics
studentHub.gpaCalculator.gpaDescription: GPA (Grade Point Average) is a numerical representation of your academic performance. It's calculated by averaging all your grades, often weighted by the number of credits each course is worth.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.weightedGPA: Weighted GPA: Some courses (like Advanced Placement or Honors) are worth more points (often up to 5.0 instead of 4.0) because they're more challenging.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.cumulativeGPA: Cumulative GPA: Your overall GPA across all semesters/years of study. This is what universities usually look at.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.unweightedGPA: Unweighted GPA: Standard 4.0 scale where all courses are treated equally, regardless of difficulty level.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.conversionMatte: Different countries use different grading systems. Universities need to understand your academic performance in their own terms. This calculator helps you convert your grades to the standards used by universities in the USA, UK, Europe, and Asia.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.addCoursesToCal: Add courses to calculate your GPA
studentHub.gpaCalculator.note1: This is an approximate conversion. Actual university evaluations may vary based on their specific admission policies.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.note2: Some universities may require official transcript evaluation services (like WES, ECE, or similar).
studentHub.gpaCalculator.note3: Always check with your target universities for their specific GPA conversion requirements.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.tip1: Make sure you're using the correct grading scale for your country/region.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.tip2: Include all required courses. Missing courses will make your GPA calculation incomplete.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.tip3: Check if your courses have different credit weights. Honors or AP courses often have higher credit values.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.tip4: Some universities calculate GPA differently (e.g., they may ignore certain courses or use different weights). Always verify with the university.
studentHub.gpaCalculator.tip5: If you're applying to multiple universities in different countries, calculate your GPA for each system separately.

caafForum.intro.0: Welcome to the first Central Asian Admissions Forum 2026! 🚀🌍
caafForum.intro.1: Are you an ambitious high school or university student in Central Asia with dreams of studying at the world's most prestigious universities?
caafForum.intro.2: Do you want to know what it truly takes to stand out in the highly competitive global admissions landscape?
caafForum.intro.3: Hosted by Top Coach, this exclusive forum is the ultimate launchpad designed to equip you with insider knowledge, actionable strategies, and a powerful network. We believe that with the right guidance, students from our region can reach the Ivy League, secure full-ride scholarships, and change their futures.
caafForum.value.0.title: Cracking the Global Code
caafForum.value.0.body: Step-by-step breakdowns of the admissions processes for top-tier universities in the US, the UK, Europe, and Asia.
caafForum.value.1.title: Building a Standout Profile
caafForum.value.1.body: Proven strategies for developing extracurricular (EC) portfolios and passion projects that catch the eye of admissions officers.
caafForum.value.2.title: Financial Aid Masterclass
caafForum.value.2.body: Insider tips on how to find and secure significant scholarships and financial aid as an international applicant.
caafForum.value.3.title: The Art of the Essay
caafForum.value.3.body: How to craft personal statements that authentically tell your unique story and highlight your strengths.
caafForum.value.4.title: High-Level Networking
caafForum.value.4.body: Unparalleled opportunities to connect with like-minded peers, mentors, and successful alumni from across the region.
caafForum.goal.ivy: Ivy League and top-tier admissions strategy
caafForum.goal.networking: Networking with mentors and admissions experts
